states.pending: a message whose identity the receiver has not processed yet
states.claimed: a message the receiver is processing right now, claimed by identity so a second reader does not take it
states.processed: a message whose identity the receiver has recorded as processed

pending_sweep.why: a .path unit only sees CHANGES, and a message written while the receiver was down leaves no change to trigger it; the receiver therefore sweeps the pending messages when it starts, so an interruption does not leave work behind
